classification.source_level_rationale: Created contemporaneously by the Swiss National Council as an official record of parliamentary proceedings.
classification.resume: This document is the official protocol of the Swiss National Council session on October 9, 1992, concerning the amendment of the Federal Law on Supplementary Benefits to Old-Age, Survivors' and Invalidity Insurance as part of the Eurolex adaptation process. It records parliamentary debate and voting on the legislative change required for Switzerland's alignment with the European Economic Area. The record is a verbatim transcript of the National Council proceedings.
